fields.Name: Harrier Du Bois
fields.Background: Harrier Du Bois is a lieutenant detective working for the Revachol Citizens Militia (RCM) in the district of Martinaise. Once a highly skilled investigator, Harrier has become infamous for his erratic behavior, substance abuse, and dramatic personal decline. After a catastrophic personal breakdown triggered by a failed romantic relationship, he went on a multi-day alcohol and drug binge that resulted in complete memory loss. When he wakes up in a trashed hostel room with no recollection of who he is, Harrier must piece together his identity while investigating a murder case. Despite his amnesia and deteriorating mental state, fragments of his exceptional detective skills remain, allowing him to approach cases from unconventional angles. His mind is a battleground of competing internal voices representing different aspects of his psyche, from logic and empathy to authority and physical prowess.
fields.Strengths: Exceptional Detective Skills: Even in his compromised state, Harrier possesses remarkable investigative abilities, able to notice details others miss and connect disparate pieces of evidence in creative ways. His intuition and deductive reasoning can be brilliant when he's focused. Versatile Skill Set: Harrier can develop expertise in multiple areas depending on his focus—from intellectual pursuits like logic and encyclopedia knowledge to physical abilities like pain tolerance and physical instrument, to interpersonal skills like empathy and suggestion. Unconventional Thinking: His fractured mind allows him to approach problems from unique perspectives that more conventional detectives might never consider. This can lead to breakthrough insights. Resilience: Despite his many failures and ongoing struggles, Harrier continues to push forward. His ability to endure physical and emotional pain is remarkable. Empathy: When he taps into his empathic abilities, Harrier can understand people on a deep emotional level, making him effective at interrogations and understanding human motivations.
fields.Weaknesses: Substance Abuse: Harrier has a severe addiction to alcohol and drugs, which has destroyed his health, relationships, and career. His dependency makes him unreliable and prone to self-destructive behavior. Mental Instability: His psyche is fractured, with competing internal voices that can lead to confusion, poor decision-making, and erratic behavior. He struggles with depression, self-loathing, and possible personality disorders. Memory Loss: The amnesia resulting from his breakdown leaves him vulnerable and without context for his relationships, past decisions, or reputation. Physical Deterioration: Years of substance abuse have taken a toll on his body. He suffers from poor health, tremors, and reduced physical capabilities. Damaged Relationships: Harrier has burned bridges with colleagues, friends, and romantic partners. His reputation precedes him, and many people view him with suspicion, pity, or contempt. Self-Destructive Tendencies: Harrier is prone to making choices that harm himself and others, whether through reckless behavior, inappropriate comments, or dwelling on his failures rather than moving forward.
